title: Recognize Exception box / abnormal use fields on the Container Selection screen as not used in this implementation
summary: Use this guide to interpret the right-hand-side “Exception box” area on the Geek Plus Container Selection screen correctly. In this implementation, the abnormal use / abnormal code location / exception-related fields are present but have not been used operationally, so they should not be treated as the site’s troubleshooting source.
when_to_use: When a support user is viewing the Geek Plus Container Selection screen and sees the right-hand-side “exception box” area with abnormal-related fields, and needs to avoid misinterpreting those fields as active operational signals for this site.
not_for: Do not use these exception/abnormal fields as the primary basis for diagnosing an operational issue on this site.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Interpret the Container Selection screen’s right-hand-side exception/abnormal fields as not used operationally in this implementation, and steer troubleshooting away from those fields unless updated site guidance is provided.

access_required: Access to the Geek Plus Container Selection screen (Container Selection HMI view).
system_preconditions: The Container Selection screen is available and shows the right-hand-side “exception box” area.

visual_references.description: Container Selection screen frame showing the right-hand-side “exception box” area and the abnormal use / abnormal code location / exception-related fields discussed in the segment.

steps.title: Open the Container Selection screen and locate the right-hand-side “exception box” area
steps.purpose: Establish the correct UI region so you interpret the abnormal-related fields in the correct context.
steps.instruction: Open the Geek Plus Container Selection screen and find the right-hand-side “exception box” area.
steps.expected_result: You can visually identify the right-hand-side “exception box” area on the Container Selection screen.
steps.healthy_condition: The screen shows the Container Selection view with the right-hand-side exception box area visible.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the exception box area or you are looking at a different screen/region than the right-hand-side exception box.

actions.label: Locate exception box area
actions.exact_action: Locate the right-hand-side “exception box” area on the Container Selection screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The segment explicitly references “abnormal use” and “abnormal code location, code location and exception something on the right hand side of that exception box. Exception box.”

steps.title: Identify the abnormal-related fields in the exception box area
steps.purpose: Confirm which fields you are looking at before applying the site-specific usage interpretation.
steps.instruction: In the exception box area, identify the abnormal-related items mentioned in the segment: abnormal use and abnormal code location / exception-related fields.
steps.expected_result: You can point to the abnormal use / abnormal code location / exception-related fields within the exception box area.
steps.healthy_condition: The abnormal-related fields are visible in the exception box area and match the types referenced in the segment.
steps.failure_condition: You are unsure which fields are the abnormal-related ones, or you are interpreting unrelated fields outside the exception box area.

actions.label: Identify abnormal-related fields
actions.exact_action: Identify the abnormal use and abnormal code location / exception-related items on the right-hand side of the exception box area.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The segment calls out “abnormal use” and “abnormal code location, code location and exception something on the right hand side of that exception box.”

steps.title: Treat exception/abnormal fields as not used operationally in this implementation
steps.purpose: Prevent incorrect troubleshooting assumptions by applying the site-specific usage scope.
steps.instruction: When you see the exception box abnormal-related fields, interpret them as present but not used operationally at this site. Use the segment’s guidance: “I haven’t seen this… we haven’t had to use this” and “we do not… we are not using” these Geek Plus exception-box features here.
steps.expected_result: You correctly conclude that the abnormal use / abnormal code location / exception-related fields are not the site’s active operational signals, so you do not base troubleshooting decisions on them.
steps.healthy_condition: Your troubleshooting approach does not treat the exception box abnormal-related fields as the primary indicator of the current operational problem for this site.
steps.failure_condition: You treat the exception box abnormal-related fields as if they are actively used by this site and chase them as the root cause without updated guidance.

actions.label: Apply site usage interpretation
actions.exact_action: Treat the exception box abnormal-related fields as not used operationally in this environment.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the site begins using exception-box features operationally (contrary to this guidance), stop and escalate for updated guidance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The segment states: “I haven’t seen this, like we haven’t had to use this… other Geek plus features… we do not… we are not using.” It further explains exception-box usage would be for end-to-end control scenarios, while this site uses Geek Plus mainly for robots and movement with custom APIs for more control.

steps.title: If asked, explain the operational scope: Geek Plus used for robots/movement with custom APIs for control
steps.purpose: Provide a consistent, source-grounded explanation that helps others interpret why exception-box features are not used here.
steps.instruction: If someone asks what the exception box abnormal-related fields mean operationally, explain that this site uses Geek Plus mainly for robots and movement, while custom APIs provide more control; exception-box features are associated with end-to-end control scenarios.
steps.expected_result: You can explain that the exception-box abnormal-related fields are not part of this site’s operational control path, because the site relies on custom APIs for end-to-end control rather than Geek Plus exception-box features.
steps.healthy_condition: Your explanation aligns with the segment’s stated scope: Geek Plus for robots/movement; custom APIs for more control; exception-box features would be used when controlling end-to-end.
steps.failure_condition: You provide an explanation that implies the exception-box abnormal-related fields are actively used operationally at this site without updated guidance.

actions.label: Explain scope
actions.exact_action: Explain that exception-box features are for end-to-end control scenarios, while this site uses Geek Plus mainly for robots and movement with custom APIs for more control.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The segment states: “So we have more control over the system… custom APIs… some features that like if they had full control… if you have an exception box, but that's when they control end to end. So we're just using them for the robots and movement.”

success_criteria: Support user can correctly interpret the exception box abnormal-related fields as present but not used operationally in this implementation.
Troubleshooting avoids treating those fields as active operational signals for this site.
healthy_conditions: Exception box abnormal-related fields are recognized as Geek Plus features not used operationally at this site.
No troubleshooting decisions are driven primarily by the exception box abnormal-related fields.
failure_conditions: Misinterpretation: abnormal use / abnormal code location / exception-related fields are treated as active operational indicators for this site.
Continued use of exception-box fields after evidence that the site has started using them operationally.
escalation_guidance: If the site begins using exception-box features operationally (contrary to the guidance in this segment), stop using this interpretation and escalate for updated guidance.
